note: One line of use for items whose use the other data files do not show (no recipe uses them yet, or they are used by the world, not a recipe). tools/item_master.py reads it; every live item must have a use line or a recipe that uses it. Add a line when you add such an item.

uses.campfire_kit: Placed on the ground as a laid fire. Press E with plant fibre, kindling, tinder, birch bark or tinder fungus in your pack to light it, then put wood in with F. Cooks, warms, lights.
uses.seed_bundle: Eaten raw, or cooked into flatbread, hearty pottage and honey loaf. Planting waits on the farming code.
uses.tree_roots: Roots from a felled tree. No use yet; planned as fibre for baskets.
uses.driftwood: Dry fuel for a fire; burns fast.
uses.soil: Dug earth. Dig and fill the ground with it.
uses.gravel: Dug gravel. Dig and fill the ground with it; planned for paths and cobble floors.
uses.rotten_food: Spoiled food: rot it down into compost (2 rotten food make 1 compost).
uses.cut_stone_block: Planned masonry: stone walls and floors with mortar (no blueprint uses it yet).
uses.brick: Built into the Clay hearth and the Brick oven (hammer blueprints); planned for brick walls and chimneys.
uses.mortar: Planned: binds stone blocks and bricks in masonry (no blueprint uses it yet).
uses.rough_plank: Retired (10 Nov 2026): the ladder takes Planks now. Kept for old saves.
uses.fine_board: Retired (10 Nov 2026): Planks do its work. Kept for old saves.
uses.cobblestone: Planned: a cobble floor and path.
uses.tar: Planned: seals a flat roof and soaks logs against rot. Needs pine tar from a felled pine.
uses.hinges: Made at a forge from an iron ingot; the plank chest blueprint uses them (doors planned).
uses.wooden_pin: Joins wood without iron; the stool and chair blueprints use them (timber frame planned).
uses.firewood_soft: Fast, short fuel for a fire (pine, spruce, fir).
uses.wooden_block_soft: Split on a chopping block into soft firewood, or shaped into a wooden hammer.
uses.tusk: A trade good: traders buy it for 20 copper (Dave 4 Nov 2026, items audit).
uses.claw: A trade good: traders buy it for 12 copper (Dave 4 Nov 2026, items audit).
uses.soap: Made and sold to traders. Washing off dirt comes with the dirtiness system (BACKLOG, LATER; Dave 4 Nov 2026).
uses.feather: Fletching for arrows and the filling of a feather bed (with down).
